name: CiteHawk API
description: REST API for a CiteHawk workspace's AI-visibility (GEO) data. Every request is scoped to the single workspace that owns the API key in the Authorization header, so callers never supply a workspace id and cannot read across tenants. Use this API to pull tracked brands, the daily visibility metrics timeseries with latest KPIs, the workspace's headline Visibility and Brand Health scores with history, and the raw AI collection responses (with citations) that power those metrics. Agency-plan keys carrying the write:prospect-scans scope can additionally start and poll white-label prospect scans. Designed for ChatGPT custom GPT Actions, Looker Studio, and any non-MCP agent framework. An MCP server with richer analysis tools is also available at https://www.citehawk.com/api/mcp.
